# LibAtrac9

The ATRAC9 decoder, from Alex Barney's LibAtrac9 (https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibAtrac9, MIT,
see `LICENSE`) at commit `efca2e3`. The first commit here is the files the build reads (`C/src`) as
they were there; later ones change them.

Left out: the C# port (`CSharp/`), the C library's Makefile and Visual Studio project files.
